learning_outcomes.text: At the end of this EC, students will be able to draw up an employment contract and understand the main clauses that employers can add, in order to appreciate what is at stake.
Know the different sources of labor law and understand the hierarchy of these standards and their complementarity.
Know how to find the right legal rules to solve a legal problem.
Draw up an employment contract: permanent and fixed-term contracts.

syllabus_topics: Discovering labor law: research of employer and employee obligations in an employment contract, different sources of labor law and situations complying with these rules.
Employment contracts: presentation of permanent and fixed-term contracts; application exercises with practical application of rules and awareness of legal risks.
Special contracts: site contracts; internal regulations; exercise with application of the principle of hierarchy of different sources of law and justification of choice.
Application: practical case study of concepts covered in new situations.
Presentation of different situations involving the engineer's liability in the context of his professional activity.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
